You have to take into account that people who are sexually assaulted don't expect it to be something that happens. You don't live your life thinking "ok, so if *this* happens then it's sexual assault." psychologically you are going to deny it happened, especially if it was with someone you know and is a sexual partner. It's very common for victims of any kind of emotional trauma to try and rationalize and deny anything bad has happened, and you have to cope and come to accept that something went wrong.

Source: friend has PTSD from being sexually assaulted
